name: edgar_proxy_statements
description:
Definitive proxy statements (DEF 14A: executive pay, board elections, shareholder votes) for one company, from SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions).
Returns {cik, company_name, statements_count, statements: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, form, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url}]}, newest first; document_url is an SEC viewer link.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits; from edgar_company_search), limit (integer 1-50, default 10).
Only the recent-filings block of the EDGAR submissions file is searched. The result lists the filings; the compensation tables are in the documents at document_url.
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "limit": 3}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).
